postal_system.postcode_rule: The UPU 05/2020 Djibouti sheet defines five numeric digits and lists ten distribution/postcode rows; the UPU August 2026 table confirms the current five-digit format. The dated public rows are reference evidence, not a proven complete 2026 assignment, alias, validity and exception denominator.
postal_system.identifier_rule: The first digit is country, the next digit region and the final three digits post office in the 05/2020 sheet. Postcode, W3W or other geocoded address, P.O. box, locality, region, office, route, building and AGID remain separately typed identities.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No rights-cleared official postal Polygon or MultiPolygon release was found. Administrative region or city polygons, post-office points, roads, address points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi or raster surfaces, OSM, model outputs and AGID cells are not postal areas.
postal_system.address_rule: UPU line order is addressee, geocoded address when possible, P.O. box, postcode plus locality, country. These fields may provide source-qualified context more detailed than a postcode but do not establish an exact building without an explicit rights-cleared relation.
postal_system.building_rule: An exact building may be displayed only from an independent rights-cleared building identity and stable explicit address-to-building relation; postcode containment, W3W text, proximity, overlap and model score are candidates only.
postal_system.licence_rule: UPU publications and the Universal POST*CODE database have copyright and database restrictions; the full 2026.1 database is contractual and the public Africa sample contains no Djibouti files. Government map access does not itself grant machine-data redistribution or postal authority. OSM remains a separate attributed ODbL partition.
postal_system.hosting_rule: Hugging Face or another host may receive only rights-cleared immutable artifacts pinned by release and SHA-256. A model may improve parsing, ranking, topology QA or compression but cannot create an assignment, postal boundary, licence or building identity.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID is an independent spatial ID. A versioned crosswalk may link permitted postcode, address, administration and building objects to AGID without relabelling an AGID cell as a canonical Djibouti postal polygon.

stages.definition: Legacy Djibouti five-digit format and general-source inventory.
Digest-bound UPU and Djibouti-government reference evidence plus deterministic authority, rights, identifier, geometry and building-detail gates.

M2 requires a complete finite current denominator of every La Poste de Djibouti five-digit assignment, alias, locality, region, post office, validity interval, correction, exception and explicit area/non-area object, fixed by retrieval time, edition, stable identity, schema, coverage, bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. Every drawable postcode must reconcile to real valid Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry with postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions. Administrative areas, office/address points, routes, buildings, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster surfaces, OSM, models and AGID cells are prohibited postal-area proxies. The approved immutable artifact must drive the real DJ API/app through normalization, loading, no-match, multiple, failure, invalid geometry, map fit, translucent fill, clear outline, metadata, clear and re-search.

agid_integration.current_scope: Source-qualified Djibouti postcode and address context plus independent AGID identity only; no production DJ Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: Complete current operator assignments, compatible rights and exact postal Polygon/MultiPolygon artifacts must pass the DJ quality gate and real API/app/browser verification.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture a postal polygon from administration, post-office points, address text, OSM, learned models or AGID cells. Detailed buildings require a separate explicit relation.
